_doc: Every item/resource. rarity: 0 Common,1 Uncommon,2 Rare,3 Epic,4 Legendary. icon = index into assets/sprites/items/items.png (16 per row). depth = [min_m, max_m]. collectible = appears in the Mineral Collection.
